{{Top|leg}}
'''Yedagon''' was a state on the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], near [[Cartann]]. The state fought with [[Red Flight]] against [[Cartann]] during the [[Adumari Civil War]]. Afterwards they fielded two [[Flightknife|flightknives]] against the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Battle of Adumar]]. They eventually became part of the [[Adumari Union]].
